caption: The drawing depicts a decorative hand fan, shown in an open position on a neutral beige background. The fan’s upper section is vibrantly colored and features a scene with several elegantly dressed figures in period attire, seated and standing on a grassy area with trees and foliage in the background; their clothing is in hues of pink, yellow, blue, and cream. The edge of the fan is adorned with detailed floral decorations in shades of pink, blue, purple, and green. The lower portion of the fan displays intricate patterns in fine black lines on a pale or possibly white surface, resembling lace or filigree work. Above the main fan, there is a separate, smaller semicircular shape outlined in light gray, decorated with delicate ornamental motifs. The fan has a central gold or brass rivet or fastener at its base. The composition mixes realistic full-color painting on the top section with monochrome, detailed line work on the lower portion and the upper outline.
title: Fan
